nsmbds-v0.4.3-alpha.description:
### Added
- Added native save functionality to the menu (Save anytime)
- Added support for Horizontal, Vertical, and Hybrid screen layouts
- Added an emulator version compatibility check

### Changed
- Changed the emulator feed to overlap the game screen instead of using additional screen space

### Fixed
- Fixed the emulator screen flipping when the window becomes too small
- Fixed the Spotlight Trap being darker in the bottom-right area
- Fixed the Spotlight Trap not working correctly with Horizontal and Hybrid layouts
- Fixed camera traps not working correctly
- Fixed Screen Flip remaining active on the overworld
- Fixed the Ground Bound Trap
- Fixed the Boo Curse Trap
- Fixed Blocksanity only detecting one block when hitting two blocks at the same time

### Important
Old seeds, save files, and savestates are not compatible with this version.

For a explanations of the randomizer and its features or installation and setup:
* **[Game Info](https://github.com/Lemix028/Archipelago-NewSuperMarioBrosDS/tree/nsmbds/worlds/nsmbds/docs/en_New%20Super%20Mario%20Bros.%20DS.md)**
* **[Setup Guide](https://github.com/Lemix028/Archipelago-NewSuperMarioBrosDS/tree/nsmbds/worlds/nsmbds/docs/setup_en.md)**
nsmbds-v0.4.3-alpha.title: New Super Mario Bros. DS v0.4.3-alpha

nsmbds-v0.4.4-alpha.description:
This update includes a major overhaul of the game logic. I rebuilt the world logic and added several options that let you control which routes may be required for progression.

The logic is much more complete now, but since this is still an alpha, it may contain incorrect or missing requirements. If you find a location that is incorrectly in or out of logic, please report it with as much information as possible.

### Added

* Added logic options for:
  * Secret Exit shortcuts within a world
  * Secret Exit world unlocks
  * Warp Cannon world routes
 _Disabled route types can still be used, but the generator will not require them for progression_
* Added an option to prevent progression items from appearing at advanced or difficult locations
* Added nine Castle boss defeats as separate Archipelago locations
* Added a minimum compatible emulator version (BizHawk 2.11.1)
* Added PopTracker view synchronization (for the upcoming PopTracker pack)

### Changed

* Rebuilt the world logic with stage-by-stage dependencies for levels, Secret Exits, Toad Houses, Star Coin Gates, Towers, and Castles
* Updated the World Tour and Completionist goals to use the new boss locations
* Added Power-Up Permit requirements to all affected checks
* Made the incompatible emulator warning much harder to overlook

### Fixed

* Fixed DeathLink triggering when returning to the overworld
* Fixed Star Coin Signs being purchasable without the required item by navigating the hidden UI
* Fixed secondary paths to the World 4 and World 7 Towers unlocking without the required item
* Fixed scrolling not working with the Horizontal and Hybrid screen layouts
* Fixed the Kivy client freezing
nsmbds-v0.4.4-alpha.title: New Super Mario Bros. DS v0.4.4-alpha
